data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaya' meaning 'body'. The name 'KayKay' signifies rejoicing and triumph. Linguistically it belongs to the Mythological tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose KayKay usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
